'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2023|2023 wildfire season]]
**[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
***[[McDougall Creek Fire]]
****[[Premier of British Columbia]] [[David Eby]] declares a province-wide [[state of emergency]] in response to the ongoing [[wildfire]]s. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/what-you-need-to-know-about-bc-wildfires-aug-18-2023-1.6940311 (CBC News)]
****The city of [[Kelowna]], [[British Columbia]], declares a state of emergency and [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]], as wildfires engulf parts of the city and surrounding area. Lake Okanagan Resort and several residential buildings are destroyed. [https://bc.ctvnews.ca/structures-burned-people-trapped-as-parts-of-b-c-s-okanagan-ordered-to-evacuate-1.6524568 (CTV News Vancouver)]
**[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
***The death toll from the wildfires in [[Maui]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States]], rises to 114. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/antoniopequenoiv/2023/08/19/maui-fire-death-toll-reaches-114-as-island-nears-containment-of-multiple-blazes/amp/ (Forbes)]
**[[2023 Washington wildfires]]
***The community of [[Medical Lake, Washington|Medical Lake]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], U.S., is evacuated due to the [[Gray Fire]] near [[Spokane, Washington|Spokane]] in eastern Washington. [https://apnews.com/article/washington-medical-lake-wildfire-905a0bbd2e0f48c200d670be10fad0bc (AP)]
*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Hilary (2023)|Hurricane Hilary]]
***The [[National Hurricane Center]] issues the first ever [[tropical storm]] watch for the [[West Coast of the United States]] in [[Southern California]] as [[Hurricane Hilary (2023)|Hurricane Hilary]] approaches from [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hurricane-hilary-baja-california-arizona-406a3f7474eacb6222cedc33993d4657 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Countess of Chester Hospital#Lucy Letby killings|Countess of Chester Hospital baby murders]]
**[[Lucy Letby]] is convicted of seven counts of [[murder in English law|murder]] and seven counts of [[attempted murder]] following the deaths of multiple babies in the neonatal unit at the [[Countess of Chester hospital]] in [[Chester]], [[England]]. Letby is acquitted on two other counts of attempted murder. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-65960514 (BBC News)]
*[[Operation Lesa Pátria]]
**The [[Federal Police of Brazil|Brazil Federal Police]] arrests seven [[Military Police (Brazil)|military police]] officers that are accused of assisting [[Right-wing politics|right-wing]] rioters and supporters of former [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] during the [[8 January Brasília attacks|January 8 attacks]] on government buildings in [[Brasília]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/brazil-arrests-7-senior-military-police-officers-jan-102382592 (ABC News)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|UN Human Rights Office]] reports that at least 2,439 people have been [[Crime in Haiti|killed]] by [[gang violence]] in [[Haiti]] this year. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20230818-more-than-2-400-killed-in-haiti-gang-violence-since-january-1-says-un (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Kurz corruption probe]]
**Former [[Chancellor of Austria]] [[Sebastian Kurz]] is charged with making [[false statements]] to a [[Austrian Parliament|parliamentary]] inquiry into alleged [[corruption in Austria|corruption]] in his [[First Kurz cabinet|first government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/austria-sebastian-kurz-charged-former-chancellor-7a9e3ba0f9f2d7e3a9827967d1cb5ba2 (AP)]
*[[Protests against the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[Moscow City Court]] dissolves the [[Sakharov Center]], a [[Human rights in Russia|human rights]] organization, for holding unauthorized conferences and exhibitions. [https://www.barrons.com/news/russia-shutters-respected-rights-group-sakharov-center-court-7397c386 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*In [[Oupeye]], [[Liège Province]], [[Belgium]], a man on a [[All-terrain vehicle|quad bike]] is shot dead by police after running over a policeman and refusing to stop at a police control. Anti-police [[riot]]s break out in the village and eleven people are arrested. [https://www.lesoir.be/531983/article/2023-08-19/tensions-apres-le-deces-dun-jeune-lors-dun-controle-de-police-oupeye-cetait-un (''Le Soir'')]
